# S27 — Set refs with ask --ref

The record schema has a `refs` field (`internal/model/record.go`), but no
command sets it, so a slicer catalog ID like C23 lives only in free text and a
lowercase tag.

## Why

S17 dogfood friction item 1. Structured refs let an agent link a decision to a
slice or catalog ID without abusing tags (C12: link by ID, no dependency).

## Files

- `internal/cli/ask.go`, `internal/commands/ask.go`: a repeatable `--ref REF` flag.
- `internal/render/*`: show refs in `show`, and in `check` and `inbox` if the implementer finds them useful there (recorded per C32).
- `internal/query/search.go`: decide (per C32) whether `check` matches refs, and record it.
- `docs/json.md`: refs already exist in the record keys; confirm the docs say how they are set.
- Tests next to each changed file.

## Failing tests

- `TestAskRef`: `adj ask ... --ref C23 --ref S20` writes `refs: ["C23","S20"]` in that order; `show` and `show --json` print them.
- `TestAskRefBlank`: a blank `--ref` is a usage error.
- The round-trip test in `cmd/adj/roundtrip_test.go` asks with a `--ref` and sees it in `show --json`.

## Implement

- Refs are opaque strings: no validation against slicer, no network or file lookups (C12, C10).
